## What are you trying to do?

Describe the use case, not just the feature — this helps us find the simplest API that solves it (sometimes an existing extension point, like a custom `validator` or `suggestionProvider`, already covers it).

## What you tried

Any existing prop/option/workaround you've attempted, and why it wasn't sufficient.

## Proposed API (optional)

If you have a concrete idea of what the API should look like, sketch it here:

```tsx
<PromQLInput yourProposedProp={...} />
```

## Would this be a breaking change?

Yes / No / Not sure — see [Versioning & Migration](https://github.com/promql-validator/promql-validator/blob/main/docs/versioning.md) for the project's compatibility policy.
